provenance.rain: NASA/JAXA GPM IMERG daily precipitation (IMERG_PRECTOT) via the NASA POWER API, native resolution, UTC days, at each upazila’s interior point
provenance.radar: Copernicus Sentinel-1 RTC gamma0 VH (Microsoft Planetary Computer, sentinel-1-rtc), every pass 15 Apr – 31 Oct, averaged to ~40 m; per field and season, each relative orbit shifted to a common median
provenance.fields: Esri | Impact Observatory | Microsoft Sentinel-2 10 m land cover: points that are cropland in both 2017 and 2025
provenance.boundaries: geoBoundaries gbOpen BGD ADM2/ADM3 (BBS / OCHA ROAP 2020), CC BY 3.0 IGO
provenance.method: public/radar/js/detect.js (detectTransplant) and stats.js (mannKendall, senSlope, benjaminiHochberg), unchanged; each upazila compared with its own 2017–2025 radar normal
provenance.licence: Sentinel-1: Copernicus open data; IMERG: NASA/JAXA open data; land cover: CC BY 4.0
